scope: Publish current-runtime schedule and native size controls; no runtime change.
limitations: Single torus surface and seed; existing public schedules only. No default change or universally superior schedule.
GPU resident timing excludes allocation/compilation/upload; native time includes domain construction, meshing and ODT. Setup/first execution reported separately.
Native criteria and counts differ. All three CPU samples, including quota-throttled samples if present, are retained. No quality-matched CPU speedup claim.
GPU full-hull/boundary checks are stronger than the retained native material quality checks; sampled RMS is not a Hausdorff bound.
reproduction: Use a separate checkout of the recorded runtime, restore original .work/vtm paths and shared helpers, replacing the workspace root as needed. Harnesses refuse overwriting outputs.
Run one GPU process at a time without concurrent heavy CPU work during clean timing. CPU quality checking follows each complete timing batch.

Use PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 WARP_CACHE_PATH=/opt/warpower-generated-cache OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 PYTHONPATH=.:.work/vtm. Build CGAL references using benchmarks/cpu instructions and the linked build record.
